# Jikan REST API v4

> Unofficial MyAnimeList.net REST API. Read-only public JSON API: anime, manga,
> characters, people, producers, magazines, genres, top/seasons/schedules,
> user profiles, random, and search. Contract is OpenAPI; rendered docs are
> Scalar. Machine/AI-first pointers are below.

## Notes
- Base URL: `https://api.jikan.moe/v4/` (local: `http://localhost:8000/v4/`).
- The v4 JSON contract is immutable for default requests; only additive opt-in
  parameters exist.
- No auth. Per-IP rate limiting is opt-in per deployment. Errors use `{status, type, message}`.
- Data is scraped from MyAnimeList and cached (per-endpoint TTL).

## Contract (machine-readable)
- OpenAPI spec: `GET /v4/docs/openapi` (JSON; regenerate with `artisan l5-swagger:generate`)
- Docs UI (Scalar): `GET /v4/docs`
- Function-calling manifest (OpenAI/Anthropic tool shapes): `GET /v4/ai/manifest.json`
- LLM index (this file): `GET /llms.txt`

## Endpoints (short)
- `anime`, `manga`, `characters`, `people` — detail + sub-resources (`/full`,
  `/characters`, `/staff`, `/voices`, `/pictures`, `/statistics`, `/reviews`, …)
- Search: `anime?q=…`, `manga?q=…`, `characters?q=…`, `people?q=…`, `users?q=…`,
  plus filters (`type`, `score`, `status`, `genres`, `order_by`, `sort`, …)
- Catalogs: `top/*`, `seasons/*`, `schedules`, `producers`, `magazines`, `genres/*`
- Community: `users/{username}/*` (profile, history, friends, animelist, reviews…)
- Meta: `/random/*`, `/recommendations/*`, `/reviews/*`, `/watch/*`
- Full surface in the OpenAPI spec or `/v4/ai/manifest.json`.
